title: From the
house supply.
scenes.text: Tap water enters at the rear. A beverage backflow preventer protects the house supply from reverse flow.
captionPhrases: Tap water enters at the rear.
A beverage backflow preventer protects the house supply
from reverse flow.

title: Refill under
pressure.
scenes.text: The diaphragm pump pushes water into the carbonator against the carbon dioxide pressure inside. A fill valve opens when more water is needed.
captionPhrases: The diaphragm pump pushes water into the carbonator
against the carbon dioxide pressure inside.
A fill valve opens when more water is needed.

title: Move the
heat out.
scenes.text: To keep that water cold, the compressor circulates refrigerant through the cold core. The condenser and fan carry the heat out through the enclosure's side grilles.
captionPhrases: To keep that water cold,
the compressor circulates refrigerant through the cold core.
The condenser and fan carry the heat out
through the enclosure's side grilles.

title: One insulated
cold core.
scenes.detail: Water and flavor share the cold.
scenes.text: Now, stay with the cold core. Inside this insulated block are the carbonator, its copper coil, and both flavor reservoirs.
captionPhrases: Now, stay with the cold core.
Inside this insulated block are the carbonator,
its copper coil, and both flavor reservoirs.

title: Insulated at
both ends.
scenes.text: Foam-filled caps close both ends. Lift them away, and the layered construction begins to appear.
captionPhrases: Foam-filled caps close both ends.
Lift them away,
and the layered construction begins to appear.

title: Beneath
the shell.
scenes.detail: A printed shell holds the insulation.
scenes.text: The printed shell holds the insulation. Beneath it, two reservoirs nest beside the coil-wrapped carbonator.
captionPhrases: The printed shell holds the insulation.
Beneath it, two reservoirs nest
beside the coil-wrapped carbonator.

title: Four parts.
One cold center.
scenes.detail: A little separation reveals the fit.
scenes.text: A little separation makes the arrangement clear. Copper above, carbonator below, and a flavor reservoir on either side.
captionPhrases: A little separation makes the arrangement clear.
Copper above, carbonator below,
and a flavor reservoir on either side.

title: Copper carries
the heat away.
scenes.text: Refrigerant evaporates inside the copper coil. Bonded around the carbonator's steel wall, it pulls heat directly from the water inside.
captionPhrases: Refrigerant evaporates inside the copper coil.
Bonded around the carbonator's steel wall,
it pulls heat directly from the water inside.

title: Cold water.
Fine bubbles.
scenes.text: The stainless steel carbonator holds water under carbon dioxide pressure. Gas enters at the bottom. An internal sparge stone spreads it into small bubbles.
captionPhrases: The stainless steel carbonator holds water
under carbon dioxide pressure.
Gas enters at the bottom.
An internal sparge stone spreads it into small bubbles.

title: Two flavors.
Both chilled.
scenes.detail: Each concentrate has its own reservoir.
scenes.text: Each reservoir holds its own concentrate. Nestled beside the carbonator, both flavors pre-chill before separate pumps send them to the faucet.
captionPhrases: Each reservoir holds its own concentrate.
Nestled beside the carbonator, both flavors pre-chill
before separate pumps send them to the faucet.

title: Everything
nests together.
scenes.detail: One core keeps water and flavor cold.
scenes.text: The coil hugs the carbonator. The reservoirs return to their pockets. The shell and caps surround them, completing one insulated cold core.
captionPhrases: The coil hugs the carbonator.
The reservoirs return to their pockets.
The shell and caps surround them,
completing one insulated cold core.

title: Back in
the machine.
scenes.detail: The working parts return to view.
scenes.text: Back in the machine, refrigeration works ahead of the cold core. Above it, pumps and valves keep each flavor ready.
captionPhrases: Back in the machine,
refrigeration works ahead of the cold core.
Above it, pumps and valves keep each flavor ready.

title: Ready for
the first drop.
scenes.text: Each peristaltic pump meters one flavor. The flavor lines stay primed and valve-locked between pours, ready when the faucet opens.
captionPhrases: Each peristaltic pump meters one flavor.
The flavor lines stay primed and valve-locked between pours,
ready when the faucet opens.

title: The pour
starts it.
scenes.detail: Flow tells the flavor pump to run.
scenes.text: Carbonated water passes through a flow sensor on its way to the faucet. Its pulses tell the machine to run the selected flavor pump.
captionPhrases: Carbonated water passes through a flow sensor
on its way to the faucet.
Its pulses tell the machine
to run the selected flavor pump.

title: Together in
your glass.
scenes.detail: Separate paths, all the way to the faucet.
scenes.text: One tube carries carbonated water. Two carry the flavors. The selected concentrate meets the water only in your glass.
captionPhrases: One tube carries carbonated water.
Two carry the flavors.
The selected concentrate meets the water
only in your glass.

title: Cold.
On tap.
scenes.text: The enclosure closes around the working parts. Water, cold, carbonation, and flavor. All under the counter. Ready at the faucet.
captionPhrases: The enclosure closes around the working parts.
Water, cold, carbonation, and flavor.
All under the counter.
Ready at the faucet.
